notes: pyo3 pinned 0.29.2 (current stable at authoring; workspace's only pyo3 dep). abi3 lives behind the truck123d 'wheel-abi3' feature (pyo3/abi3) so `maturin build --features wheel-abi3` emits a PEP 384 limited-API wheel; on pyo3 0.29 the old extension-module cargo feature is obsolete (maturin >= 1.9.4 sets PYO3_BUILD_EXTENSION_MODULE). auto-initialize is dev-dependency-only so `cargo test -p truck123d` can embed an interpreter for the exception/GIL tests without leaking into the shipped module. GIL mechanism: one choke point `gil::with_kernel_gil_released`, implemented as pyo3 0.29 `Python::detach` (the allow_threads rename). Test 4 proves release with a second thread: main holds the GIL, spawns an observer whose `Python::attach` can only complete while the GIL is free, then runs a landed kernel call (evidence-algebra `Modulus::compose`, truck-base, zero geometry) inside the detached closure and waits (bounded 10s mpsc) for the observer's signal; if the GIL were not released the observer never signals and the test fails on the bound, never hangs. Refusal fidelity: exhaustive `Marshaled::from_refusal` match over every landed `Refusal` variant (all six EnvelopeCase payloads, all five UnresolvedWitness payloads) into exactly the two typed classes; payloads are serde structs round-tripped losslessly through JSON and carried on the Python exception as `payload` + flattened attrs (built via serde + json.loads, never pickled). Zero geometry: no facade call, no math. Done-when gates all green: fmt --check, clippy --all-targets -D warnings, `cargo test -p truck123d` (4/4), `cargo check --workspace --all-targets`. Wheel build (maturin) is CI/out-of-scope; the Python smoke was nevertheless executed for real by importing the dev-built cdylib under the local CPython 3.14 (module init, TruckError/Refused/Unresolved hierarchy, opaque TruckSolid, certified compose, and typed Refused raised on an unbounded compose). Operational note for rerunning tests here: the embedded interpreter is not on PATH, so python314.dll was placed app-local in target/debug/deps and test 4 bootstraps PYTHONHOME from the `python` prefix before interpreter init.
